verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API, so natural-language operation is possible through an external agent. Agent-readable llms.txt and .md docs also support this. However, nothing shows that the MCP tools cover Identity verification sessions, or that the product has its own natural-language interface. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes Identity operations (creating sessions, reviewing results, overrides), a native natural-language interface, and hands-on corroboration.
